id: title:JakeRuth:keep reading chats whose checkpoints hold a retired message type

review.posthog_relevance: Checks compatibility and recovery of HogQL checkpoint messages against current schema, retaining only supported message types.
review.reason: Adds a Prometheus counter and a message-filtering utility to record dropped checkpoint messages and exclude retired message types when loading checkpoints. This supports compatibility and recovery of HogQL checkpoint messages against current schema, retaining only supported message types.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected.

observations.behavior: Adds Prometheus counter and a message-filtering utility.
observations.posthog_connection: Records dropped checkpoint messages when loading a checkpoint whose message types are no longer supported by the current schema, aiding observability of compatibility issues.

observations.behavior: Defines a set of retired message types and a function to remove them from checkpoint message lists.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the checkpointer to recognize and exclude messages of types that have been removed from the HogQL or backend schema, preventing checkpoint loading failures.

observations.behavior: Applies the retirement-filtering function when loading checkpoint channel values.
observations.posthog_connection: Ensures that when loading a checkpoint, messages of retired types are stripped before the checkpoint is used, preserving conversation continuity despite schema changes.
